descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating Azmaveth (עַזְמָוֶת), used as a personal name for several individuals (one of David's mighty warriors in 2 Sam 23:31, 1 Chr 11:33; a Benjaminite in 1 Chr 12:3; a treasurer in 1 Chr 27:25; and a post-exilic family head in Ezra 2:24, Neh 12:29) and as a place name (Beth-Azmaveth, Neh 7:28). All three clusters represent the same name in different syntactic positions: standalone nominative (S123389), conjunction-prefixed 'and Azmaveth' (S123390), and another nominative occurrence (S123391). Multilingual translations consistently render one name: Spanish 'Azmávet / Azmavet,' Hindi 'अज्मावेत / अज़्मावेत,' Arabic 'عَزْمَاوَت / عَزموَتَ,' Korean '아스마웻 / 아스마볳 / 아즈마벳,' Swahili 'Azmavethi / Azmawethi.'
